art.name: Brace Yourself
art.sequence: Two sculpted forearm/forepaw guard silhouettes lower and brace, interlocking bronze-grey layered shell plates close around empty central sprite space, absorb a tiny harmless test ripple, settle firmly, then unlock. Texture plates and joints; no damage explosion.

art.name: Sound Off
art.sequence: a compact orb or knot of energy that blooms outward on contact.

art.name: Rattling Cry
art.sequence: A jagged vibrating sound pressure front breaks into uneven staccato bands; successive short pulses, then an abrupt silence. A cry, not a projectile orb.

art.name: Resounding Clap
art.sequence: Two short opposing pressure fronts meet like hands clapping; a single flat white impact and concentric compressed sound bands ring out. Different from a cry.

art.name: First Footfall
art.sequence: A single powerful forepaw makes its FIRST grounded step: heel draws back, sole accelerates, plants sharply, compact dust and stone chips kick forward at contact, toes flex, then lift. The actual foot and ground response are readable.

art.name: Parting Feint
art.sequence: A faint false claw silhouette feints to upper right while a sharply lit real claw strikes suddenly from lower left. The decoy dissolves, contact opens on the opposite diagonal, angular impact flecks and displaced dust follow, then real claw withdraws.

art.name: Gathering Pace
art.sequence: Three successive forward paw placements accelerate with increasingly compressed silver wind streamers. A shoulder-like blunt silhouette compresses into a sharp collision and the streamlined wake stretches smoothly forward after contact, communicating gathered speed. Not the same single foot stamp as First Footfall.

art.name: Steady Blow
art.sequence: A dense shaded bare forepaw/fist draws back, holds steady, swings ONE controlled compact arc, lands a clean blunt contact with a short pressure rim, follows through and withdraws. No claws, projectile, blade or repeated hit.

art.name: Measured Cut
art.sequence: One finely edged silver crescent blade aligns carefully, sweeps a broad horizontal lateral cut with THREE tapering motion trails (not three contacts), makes a precise narrow white contact notch and follows through, shedding tiny steel flecks.

art.name: Quick Wit
art.sequence: A faceted clear focus lens unfolds from small overlapping glass slivers, subtle sight-lines converge into a precise iris around empty sprite space, the lens focuses to a calm steady glint and folds away. Accuracy self buff: no attack, no readable text, no damage contact.

art.name: Second Wind
art.sequence: A tired curled ribbon of breath expands into a second deeper mint-and-ivory inhalation, flows gently inward around empty sprite space, tiny warm restorative motes settle into a renewed pulsing breath, then dissipate. Healing breath, not flowers or a damaging vortex.

art.name: Sure Stride
art.sequence: Two grounded pawprint shapes take measured sure steps around empty sprite space; a compact pale wind aura tightens and a single grounded pressure ring settles beneath the prints. Speed self buff, no damaging collision, no charging shoulder.

art.name: Full Commitment
art.sequence: An anonymous heavy shoulder/ram silhouette crouches low and commits to one ALL-OUT straight charge. Broad compressed ivory air wedges trail behind, heavy collision splinters the air, the mass follows through and visibly slows into a strained recovery with falling dust. No repeated fast footwork.

art.name: Rolling Momentum
art.sequence: A solid rounded body/stone-like mass curls and ROLLS end over end through shaded dust curls, contacts once with a weighted impact, rebounds slightly and keeps rotating with forward momentum before uncoiling. Show actual rotation rather than a generic rush streak.

art.name: Reckless Follow-through
art.sequence: A long heavy claw/edge winds far back, slashes wide past the contact point, overshoots and sends a secondary recoil jolt back along its own trail before an off-balance recovery. Make reckless overextension clear, one contact with target, no extra target hits.

art.name: Firefly Volley
art.sequence: Tiny individually winged gold fireflies kindle one by one in a loose staggered crescent, fold into a coordinated fast diagonal swarm sweep, converge in ONE luminous puncture burst, then separate into embers streaming forward with acceleration. Visible insect wing shapes, not a generic fireball.

art.name: Branding Iron
art.sequence: A blackened iron branding stamp with a unique branching rune heats from black to dull red to white-hot edges, moves forward in foreshortening, presses flat with ONE forceful smoky sizzle, leaves a seared rune suspended briefly, stamp recoils backwards and smoky mark fades. Recognisable forged iron tool, glowing thermal texture.

art.name: Pyre Detonation
art.sequence: A tight knot of charred interlocking pyre sticks gathers dry charcoal fragments, orange light leaks through cracks, explosive pressure splits the pyre apart in a single broad concussive blast, flying burning splinters and ash billow then descend and extinguish. This is a pyre fuel detonation rather than a spherical flame projectile.

art.name: Cinder Rend
art.sequence: Two opposing asymmetrical jaw crescents formed from rough black coal fangs open wide, serrated ember teeth mesh in a single violent snapping bite across center, charcoal fragments tear outward, jaws pull apart and crumble. Convincing tooth forms and closing movement, no generic slash ring.

art.name: Scorchwhip
art.sequence: A long tapered glowing ember lash slowly coils with a heavy charcoal handle knot at lower left, uncoils and snaps rapidly through a narrow S-curve, its tip cracks exactly once at upper right producing a thin white hot scorch seam, lash overshoots and recoils with falling ember scales, fades. No flag, no sword, clearly flexible whip.

art.name: Hotfoot
art.sequence: A small light clawed foot heats at its toe tips, crouches briefly, leaps in a low short skimming streak, lands toe-first in a compact fiery scuff, slides a short distance with three claw grooves and skips away. This is a quick light burning toe skid, distinct from a big pounce or a heavy planted footfall.

art.name: Charcoal Hook
art.sequence: A hooked clenched charcoal-black forepaw winds back with a loaded elbow arc, drives forward in a fast hooking punch across center with orange fissures, collides in one compressed spark burst, over-rotates and jerks backward with a small recoil shudder, sheds soot chips and unclenches. The limb is sculpted charcoal with red cracks, not a recoloured flesh fist.

art.name: Ash Wheel
art.sequence: A rim of layered drifting grey ash flakes assembles around an ember hub, spins in a tilted vertical plane and rolls diagonally forward, rim flexes and splashes ash on one contact point, keeps rolling through before disintegrating into a thin rolling ash wake. Fine grey layers with sparse orange rim coals, not a solid stone ball or flame ring.

art.name: Stoke the Heart
art.sequence: A tiny coal heart with anatomical chamber-like faceted volumes gently opens, inward-drawn small ember motes fan into its chambers, it warms from deep garnet to gold in two steady glowing pulses, protective heat lines settle close around heart, the glow rests and contracts to a single steady cinder. SELF special attack buff, no damaging strike or contact explosion.

art.name: Kiln Kiss
art.sequence: A smooth translucent ceramic-pink crescent of kiln glaze emerges from paired delicate licking flames, sweeps diagonally once like the edge of a glowing porcelain cup, makes a small soft but searing white ceramic contact impression, glaze fractures into tiny iridescent flakes and fine lingering heat haze, fades. Refined curved kiln glaze stroke, no whip or biting jaws.

art.name: Kiln Scissor
art.sequence: Two articulated black fired-clay shears with copper pivots open into a wide V, ember-red cutting edges heat, swing together from opposite diagonals and slam shut once across center with a hard white hot cross contact, cutting dust flies; shears jolt apart backwards from recoil then cool and lower. Distinct hinged shears rather than teeth. Powerful physical attack with recoil.

art.name: Cinder Pounce
art.sequence: Two heavy ember-coated feline forepaws curl in preparation, lift and arc together in a pronounced high pounce parabola, descend claws-first into ONE broad double-paw impact with cinder rubble, compress deeply then recoil backwards shedding coal flakes and smoky heat. Distinct heavy two-paw airborne pounce, not Hotfoot's single light toe skid.

art.name: Brand Lunge
art.sequence: A long barbed ember spear point and its charcoal socket pull back, align horizontally, lunge forward with a compressed straight thrust, stamp ONE sharp branded star on contact, then drag heavily backwards shedding cinders as the speed cost. Distinct piercing heavy physical lunge, no branding stamp tool or fist.

art.name: Heat Haze
art.sequence: Thin warm air ribbons rise around empty target space, wavy offset lens facets refract a small central sight glint into displaced ghost images, distort and settle as a restrained mirage veil, then gently fade. Foe accuracy reduction; no damaging impact, no flame orb or protective shield.

art.name: Kindled Heart
art.sequence: Two dark sculpted creature hands approach with open fingers, form an empty heart-shaped space between their knuckles, warm golden motes gather into that hollow, the hands close into two powerful fists with bright heated tendon-like lines, then relax apart as motes subside. Physical ATTACK self buff. No anatomical organ, clearly distinct from Stoke the Heart's literal coal heart.

art.name: Smoulder Veil
art.sequence: Soft charcoal-grey smoke unspools from five small smouldering feather-like scales, wraps in overlapping translucent draped bands around empty user silhouette space, small incoming orange sparks visibly fizzle against the cool outer soot layer, veil settles then unravels gently. SELF special defence and burn immunity; no strike or explosive flash.

art.name: War Flame
art.sequence: A small red ember seal between two rugged forearm gauntlets splits and is consumed inward, leaving a brief dim gap that communicates personal cost; the braced gauntlets rise as two distinct tall braided war flames unfurl behind them, flare steadily with strength and forward speed wisps, then cool and lower. Self attack/speed buff at HP cost, no enemy collision or damage burst; not a battle flag or literal heart.

art.name: Drowned Ember
art.sequence: a dark ember drops into a curling blue-black flame, briefly smothered by a ring of spectral water before reigniting as a ghostly orange flare on the target.

art.name: Infernal Prowl
art.sequence: four low ember footprints appear one after another in darkness, accelerate toward the target, and culminate in a prowling flame-claw burst.

art.name: Little Conqueror
art.sequence: A tiny crimson battle standard plants at one side, three escalating marching impact steps advance left to right, then a commanding crest-shaped solid impact lands and the banner settles. Bespoke miniature conquest choreography, no generic fireball.

art.name: Red Banner Rush
art.sequence: a long crimson flame-and-wind banner trail streams behind a charging streak, whips once across the target, and detonates into a red-gold impact burst.

art.name: Deepwater Brace
art.sequence: Several thick lens-shaped layers of deep teal water descend slowly and stack into a heavy flattened pressure arch over empty user space, small bubbles compress between strata, the arch firms into a dense braced water canopy absorbing a restrained ripple, then layers relax upward and separate into bubbles. Special defence self buff; no bronze armour, no attack wave.

art.name: Breakwater
art.sequence: A pale foaming vertical wave wall rises, a heavy dark-water wedge surges into it at right angles, the wall fractures into separate curled slabs of water around a single immense physical contact, foam and pebble chips kick backward in recoil, slabs collapse into low splashes and droplets. Powerful physical attack with recoil; recognisable broken wave wall, no sphere.

art.name: Keel Rend
art.sequence: Three narrow hooked keel-like fins of dark dense water rise together, draw back in a loaded claw rake, sweep down diagonally as three distinct curved cutting trails converging on ONE rending contact, drag a heavy low backwash and withdraw slowly with floating keel splinters. Single-hit physical clawing attack with speed cost, not a projectile lance.

art.name: Undertow Hook
art.sequence: A heavy corroded anchor hook emerges from coiling low undertow, sinks with a weighted straight descent, catches and pivots into one powerful upward hook impact from below, tears loose foam and grit in a suction ring, then sinks back into the receding water. Distinct sculpted hooked mass and downward-then-upward movement.

art.name: Foam Lance
art.sequence: A slender compressed water needle with a dense foamy spearhead elongates from a tight bead, accelerates straight across center in a precise piercing thrust, punches through once with a small narrow star of spray, its trailing shaft unravels into elongated bubbles and fine droplets. Special piercing attack; no broad wave or curved claw.

art.name: Foam Pulse
art.sequence: A small pearly foam knot vibrates, releases three precisely separated expanding circular ripple rings, rings pass outward while a dense central bubble contracts, ONE concentrated bright core flash provides the actual damage contact, hollow foam bubbles wobble irregularly and dissipate afterward. Three preparatory pressure rings, only ONE impact, distinctive from Foam Lance.

art.name: Riptide Scissor
art.sequence: Two opposing crescent liquid blades pull apart in counter-rotating currents, close across center in a single scissoring water impact, cut foam fragments spray outward while a narrow separate restorative backflow thread returns toward the origin, then both blade currents unwind into droplets. Physical damaging attack with draining backflow. Liquid scissor currents, no solid scissors tool or handles.

art.name: Mist Screen
art.sequence: Fine cool droplets rise into a thin vertical plane like a fogged window, a translucent grey-blue curtain slides across empty target space and breaks a small sight glint into blurred displaced copies, then the screen thins and lifts. Foe accuracy reduction, no damage flash or attack collision. A flat fog screen, not Heat Haze's rising warm refraction ribbons.

art.name: Tidal Poise
art.sequence: Scattered droplet masses wobble around an empty standing-user space, collect into two opposed substantial curved water cuffs at shoulder/forearm level, brace symmetrically above a quiet shallow pool, absorb a tiny balanced ripple and settle, then relax into drops. Physical defence self buff; balanced braced wave arms, not Deepwater Brace's stacked pressure canopy.

art.name: Tide Break
art.sequence: One sculpted open hand made of dense sea water draws back with fingers spread, drives its broad palm forward once, compresses into a flat forceful contact, fractures into five distinct finger-shaped water facets and spray, then the facets fall into a low pool. Physical palm impact with fracturing water motif; not a tall wave wall or a closed fist.

art.name: Coral Lunge
art.sequence: Three richly textured branching coral talons emerge from a short coral wrist base, pull back, lunge together on converging curved paths, meet in ONE pointed piercing contact, shed pink coral grit and fine foam, then retract and cool. Physical hard coral claw action with three preparatory trails but one hit; no giant water claw or generic orb.

art.name: Keel Hammer
art.sequence: A heavy worn keel-timber hammerhead encrusted with tiny barnacles lifts on a short water-formed haft, swings down with visible weight into ONE low smashing contact, wood chips and a broad circular shock ripple spread, hammer bounces once and lowers into the receding foam. Distinct descending weighted keel hammer, not an anchor hook.

art.name: Tide Lance
art.sequence: Three short vertical jets align and compress into one narrow translucent ribbed water spear with an angular glass-like pointed head, tilt diagonally and spear straight through target space once, then fracture into sharp liquid facets and a sparse straight droplet line. A rigid pressure spear with angular ribs, clearly distinct from Foam Lance's soft pearly bubbling dart. Keep the complete short spear compact within each cell.

art.name: Tide Pulse
art.sequence: A thin upright dense-water membrane stretches like an oval diaphragm, a falling droplet plucks it inward, it releases two expanding ridged pressure rings, folds tightly into ONE concentrated core pulse and springs outward, then shivers and breaks into flat droplets. Special attack weakening defence. A vibrating membrane and pressure ridges, not Foam Pulse's pearly bubble cloud.

art.name: Undertow Reap
art.sequence: A narrow hooked scythe edge of dark water rises from a low undertow stream, shoots forward in a compact oblique streak, pinches into ONE sharp hooked collision at center, tears a notch through the stream and trails fine cut foam fragments before draining away. A fast narrow reaping hook, no heavy anchor, no healing backflow.

art.name: Monsoon Detonation
art.sequence: Fine diagonal rain bands gather into one clearly corkscrewing beaded stream, wrap ONCE around empty target space, squeeze into a dense rain knot and burst radially in ONE monsoon detonation, a thin separate restorative backflow thread returns toward the origin while individual rain drops fall and vanish. Single special draining hit; not opposing water scissor blades or an endless tornado.

art.name: Tide Sweep
art.sequence: A shallow broad tide ribbon unfurls low from one side, rises into a wide horizontal water curtain sweeping across most of empty target silhouette, lands ONE sustained low sweeping contact, breaks into rolling foam rows while a narrow restorative droplet thread returns toward origin, then the entire curtain recedes into a sparse line. Physical draining sweep; no anchor, scythe, lance or repeated impacts.

art.name: Jaffa Breaker
art.sequence: A segmented golden-orange water disc divides into two foaming crescents, collides on the target and disperses into droplets.

art.name: Static Warning
art.sequence: Many fine conductive hair-like filaments rise around empty user space, tiny dust motes are attracted to their pointed ends, each filament stiffens and branches with contained gold static, a steady charged outline settles without jumping to any foe, then the filaments lower and sparks subside. Self special attack buff; warning charge stored rather than an electrical explosion.

art.name: Circuit Breaker
art.sequence: A small detailed bronze knife-switch opens on a hinge and breaks two protective ceramic guard plates apart, the exposed switch body shifts rapidly twice leaving two thin fading positional afterimages, discarded plates fall away as a steady streamlined charge remains, then the switch lowers and the ghosts fade. Self speed+2 with defence-1, no damaging discharge. A physical opening switch and discarded protection, not Alien Circuit's assembled attack lattice.

art.name: Live Wire
art.sequence: A loose physical electrical wire whips forward, bends around the target, contacts with a few local sparks, then springs away. A wire, not a generic lightning orb.

art.name: Alien Circuit
art.sequence: thin electric-blue circuit paths draw themselves in midair as angular alien geometry, charge with yellow-white sparks, then discharge through the target in a branching grid.

art.name: Kindness Gathers
art.sequence: small leaf-green and peach-pink motes drift in from several directions, gather around the user and allies, then settle as warm healing sparkles. Do not use a damaging contact flash; the visual climax is the aura, mark, field, healing bloom or barrier settling into place.

art.name: Oathkeeper's Edge
art.sequence: a jade-green crescent blade of leaf energy forms from braided vines, swings in one disciplined diagonal arc, and sheds a few bright leaf fragments after contact.

art.name: Celestial Rime
art.sequence: small star-like ice crystals gather overhead, descend in a graceful spiral, and fuse into one pale celestial frost bloom on the target.

art.name: Measured Force
art.sequence: Two articulated bronze forepaws align and close slowly; fine force lines gather into a steady central glint, then hands relax. Self attack buff without target impact.

art.name: Firm Footing
art.sequence: Two textured clawed feet plant and grip; angular stone braces lock around soles, resist a lateral gust and relax. Self defence and anchoring buff.

art.name: Iron Blow
art.sequence: Wrapped iron-grey martial forearm draws back, makes one short precision knuckle punch with compressed pressure halo, then withdraws.

art.name: Dune Break
art.sequence: A granular sandstone ridge is struck at its base by compressed sand; visible cracks split it at one contact, blocks collapse and grit settles.

art.name: Clay Hook
art.sequence: A compact earthen forearm curls low, drives one upward clay hook, spatters wet clay at contact, hardens those spatters into layered defensive cuffs, then lowers. Detailed sculpted clay hand; no whole character.

art.name: Feather Veil
art.sequence: Ivory flight feathers overlap around empty user space; displaced feather ghosts and thin air obscure the centre, then separate. Self evasion veil.

art.name: Jetstream Detonation
art.sequence: A braided air jet compresses into one pressure knot and detonates into a torn membrane; cloud fragments drift away.

art.name: Featherweight
art.sequence: Three delicate feather-tipped talon quills flex and sweep together in one weightless claw rake; three curved trails converge at ONE contact, white barbs drift away and tips uncurl. No full bird.

art.name: Tailwind Cry
art.sequence: A feathered throat and beak give a short cry; soft sound rings draw out streamlined feather wisps into a settling tailwind. Self speed buff.

art.name: Ancient Nodule
art.sequence: a rough prehistoric stone nodule spins slowly into view, cracks along glowing fossil seams, then launches compact fragments in a dense rock burst.

art.name: Night Feint
art.sequence: An off-centre dark false strike appears briefly; it vanishes, then the real compact cut contacts from the opposite side. Misdirection before impact.

art.name: Iron Lance
art.sequence: A long solid steel lance point thrusts forward rapidly and punctures at one tiny bright contact, then withdraws. Straight piercing motion, not a slash.

art.name: Iron Strike
art.sequence: A broad blunt riveted steel striker on a short articulated shank draws back, strikes one downward diagonal with flat weighted contact, chips scatter, then rebounds and retracts. No sharpened sword or fist.

art.name: Benevolent Bloom
art.sequence: a warm pink-gold blossom opens beneath the user, layered petals of light rise around the sprite space, and a gentle green healing glow closes inward. Do not use a damaging contact flash; the visual climax is the aura, mark, field, healing bloom or barrier settling into place.

art.name: Concord Pact
art.sequence: two soft fairy-light ribbons circle separately, cross into a glowing knot between allies, then release a gentle starry pulse outward.

art.name: Clockwork Current
art.sequence: A small mechanical gear train engages tooth by tooth, a current jumps along the meshed teeth, then releases in a compact directed discharge. Real clockwork silhouette.

art.name: Padded Uppercut
art.sequence: A broad padded fist-like contact silhouette rises from low to high, ending in a strong upward compression impact and a small dust fall. Not flames or an elemental orb.

art.name: Fern Circuit
art.sequence: A fern frond unfolds branch by branch, a tiny electrical signal traces the leaflet tips, and the leafy circuit discharges. Fern identity, not a generic type symbol.

art.name: Spore Signal
art.sequence: Several shaded mushroom spores float in a staggered relay; a tiny signal jumps from spore to spore, then disperses in a small granular impact.

art.name: Anvil Shoulder
art.sequence: A heavy armoured shoulder plate rushes horizontally and compresses a squat anvil-shaped impact; short heavy recoil and falling metal chips.

art.name: Dream Ripple
art.sequence: A little dreamlike reflection appears, slow irregular ripples bend it, then the reflection softly folds inward; muted moonlit colours and calm timing.

art.name: Obsidian Shelter
art.sequence: Solid black volcanic glass slabs rise and interlock around the user into a low shelter, facets catching sparse warm highlights; settle protectively without attack flash.

art.name: Dusk Guillotine
art.sequence: A heavy broad dark execution blade drops vertically in one committed cut, pauses at its contact, then dust and tiny metal chips settle. Not a swooping claw swipe.

art.name: Malagigi's Mirror
art.sequence: An ornate small arcane mirror materialises, catches a bright image, splits the reflection into several offset panes, and snaps a precise reflected pulse back.

art.name: Heatglass Edge
art.sequence: A solid heated glass blade grows a bright molten rim, makes one broad horizontal cutting pass, then irregular amber glass splinters cool into dark fragments. The blade action comes first.

art.name: Rill Pulse
art.sequence: A compact rippling water pulse with droplets and a splash impact.

art.name: Focus Breath
art.sequence: Measured breath wisps drawing inward, then a calm focus highlight.

art.name: Veil of Quiet
art.sequence: Layered drifting pixel mist, with soft shapes built from clusters rather than blur.

art.name: Undertow Mark
art.sequence: A dark current closes around the target and leaves a readable brief mark.

art.name: Brine Veil
art.sequence: A curved sheet of shaded water with a riposte-ready glint.

art.name: Salt in the Wound
art.sequence: Sharp briny water bursts and salt-like sparkles at the wound; remove the triangle emblem.

art.name: Nightwater Pulse
art.sequence: A dense dark-water surge with a different cadence from Rill Pulse.

art.name: Reversal Current
art.sequence: An incoming current turns and lashes back; direction change is the identity.

art.name: Stillwater Meditation
art.sequence: Water settles around the user before a restrained rising focus cue.

art.name: Blackwater Requiem
art.sequence: Distinct large dark-water choreography with a deliberate closing impact.

art.name: Blank Horizon
art.sequence: A low fog sweep erases visible boost motifs.

art.name: Deluge Lance
art.sequence: A concentrated water lance with a forceful splash and trailing spray.

art.name: Moonlit Reprisal
art.sequence: A reflective moonlit surface catches an impact and returns it.

art.name: Kitten’s Draft
art.sequence: Small playful wind curls and leaf scraps.

art.name: Downfall Feathers
art.sequence: Shaded feathers drift and sweep across the target.

art.name: Berry Supper
art.sequence: A recognisable berry consumption beat followed by recovery motes.

art.name: Orchard Updraft
art.sequence: Rising air lifts leaves in a broad upward flow.

art.name: Shearwind
art.sequence: Several narrow wind blades with crisp cutting contacts.

art.name: Draining Roots
art.sequence: Roots visibly grow towards and bind the target.

art.name: Orchard Nap
art.sequence: The user settles beneath foliage; recovery gathers gently.

art.name: Orchard Carpet
art.sequence: Low foliage spreads across the field with readable terrain boundaries.

art.name: Spore Drowse
art.sequence: A sleepy drifting spore cloud with a distinct settling beat.

art.name: Souring Sap
art.sequence: Thick shaded sap spatters and leaves a brief toxic residue.

art.name: Heartwood Siphon
art.sequence: Energy travels from the target back through a root-like stream.

art.name: Pantry Refill
art.sequence: A berry reforms or returns to the holder, followed by a small confirmation sparkle.

art.name: Cloudwool Mantle
art.sequence: Layered cotton tufts gather into a padded protective coat.

art.name: Breeze Relay
art.sequence: A directional leaf-and-air handoff towards the selected replacement.

art.name: Canopy Cleave
art.sequence: A broad cutting wind arc breaks through a sweep of leaves.

art.name: Goading Glance
art.sequence: A sharp eye/glance cue and brief provocation reaction.

art.name: Deep Burrow
art.sequence: A settling rest sequence with a clear sleep finish.

art.name: Dream Murmur
art.sequence: A dream pulse resolves into the called move; preserve the follow-on animation.

art.name: Widewater Rush
art.sequence: A broad travelling water sheet with foam and a heavy landing.

art.name: Dusk Snarl
art.sequence: A jagged dark sound wave with distinct pulsed contacts.

art.name: Cooling Rill
art.sequence: A fine cool stream with restrained frosty highlights, not an ice beam.

art.name: Binding Eddy
art.sequence: A persistent circular water pull with an obvious centre.

art.name: Sanctuary Air
art.sequence: A field-side sheltering air curtain.

art.name: Pollen Snare
art.sequence: Pollen catches around the target and resolves into a paralysis cue.

art.name: Bitter Pollen
art.sequence: A distinct toxic pollen cloud with falling granular residue.

art.name: Wakeful Seed
art.sequence: A seed opens in a short bright alertness pulse.

art.name: Clearcut Breeze
art.sequence: A forceful sweep disperses screen/hazard motifs.

art.name: Refrain Lock
art.sequence: A repeating closed rhythm around the target communicates the move lock.

art.name: Leafbound Exit
art.sequence: A contact strike, leaf wake, and directional retreat into the replacement.

art.name: Hoarfrost Lance
art.sequence: A crisp shaded ice lance, crystalline impact and falling ice chips.

art.name: Stillwater · Threefold Answer
art.sequence: Three clean sword cuts, followed by glass fracturing and shattering; no water effects.

art.name: Berry Pantry · Recovery
art.sequence: A real ripe berry re-forms from a tiny pip beside the holder, solid shaded fruit flesh and a leaf appear, then a subtle confirmation glint; no elemental emblem.

art.name: Draining Roots · Siphon
art.sequence: Fine roots grip the victim; small warm life-energy beads travel inward along them towards the beneficiary; roots settle after the transfer. No violent collision.

art.name: Brine Veil · Riposte
art.sequence: A single compact decisive ivory sword cut through a translucent glass-like guard, with a few sharp splinters; do not add water spray.

art.name: Nectarbane
art.sequence: Textured opposed thorn vines close; shaded dark lotus opens at poison contact; violet spores disperse and an amber sap droplet returns. Sixteen authored pixel-art phases; gameplay still gates recovery on successful new poison.

art.name: Static Detonation
art.sequence: A small tangled static knot winds tighter; one asymmetrical electrical detonation ruptures its shell into barbed filaments, then the filaments gutter away. No thundercloud or generic fire explosion.

art.name: Livewire Rend
art.sequence: Three exposed copper-wire claws flex, rake together once diagonally through one contact, shed little blue sparks from their frayed insulation, then withdraw. No whole creature.

art.name: Coil Hook
art.sequence: A thick spring-wound copper hook compresses, drives one upward hooking punch, flexes from recoil and loosens into separated spring turns. Mechanical hook shape, not a fist.

art.name: Spark Dash
art.sequence: A narrow wingless arrowhead of compressed speed-lines accelerates low left-to-right, touches once in a tiny hooked spark, then coasts into thin broken dashes. Speed travel dominates; no full creature.

art.name: Arcwire Scissor
art.sequence: Two jointed wire-cutter jaws with crackling copper cutting edges open, close once around a small central corona, then spring open and shed one backward recoil spark. No whole character.

art.name: Spark Jolt
art.sequence: One tiny white-hot electrical bead gathers two short sparks, darts a short distance, snaps once into a compact jagged flash, then dwindles into three motes. Small quick basic projectile.

art.name: Spark Ring
art.sequence: An incomplete floating copper spark-loop closes into a thin oval ring, rotates forward, tightens once into a bright central pinprick, then unwinds into a graceful trailing spiral.

art.name: Copper Lunge
art.sequence: A narrow pointed copper ram prow pulls back, lunges forward horizontally with polished copper highlights, makes one pointed contact and draws out into two thin acceleration trails. No hammer or body.

art.name: Static Field
art.sequence: Several separated low charge nodes lift tiny filaments into an oval floor lattice; softly crackling static settles between the nodes and remains low, then fades. Debuff field only: no explosion, lightning strike, hit star or damage contact.

art.name: Thunderhead Resonance
art.sequence: Three compact layered charcoal thundercloud lobes compress like a bellows; a luminous vibrating core opens beneath them, delivers one broad concentric thunder-pressure pulse, then the lobes lose charge and dissipate. No repeated strikes.

art.name: Livewire Hammer
art.sequence: A blunt rectangular hammerhead woven from thick live copper cables lifts, swings down once, strikes with crushed wire strands and a sharp corona, rebounds heavily and drops one backward recoil spark. No biting jaws, no full character.

art.name: Volt Jolt
art.sequence: A thick short stepped lightning lance assembles from offset rectangular voltage plates, travels into one angular impact, cracks the outer plates and collapses to fading afterimages. Heavier layered projectile than Spark Jolt.

art.name: Livewire Tackle
art.sequence: A broad rounded armored shoulder-shaped mass wrapped in live wires braces, makes one low horizontal body-check with a blunt shoulder impact, recoils and retracts; no head, full creature, feet or arrowhead.

art.name: Storm of Youth
art.sequence: A single reckless zigzag bolt bends twice while travelling toward ONE contact; a wide blue-violet discharge opens at that contact, and one small backward recoil spark traces its return. Travel bends are not separate hits.

art.name: Thornwake
art.sequence: A tight sleeping rosebud of dark thorns swells, opens into one directional fan of rising thorn shoots, releases a few soft sleepy gold pollen motes after impact and withers. No generic green orb.

art.name: Leaf Cut
art.sequence: One serrated curved leaf blade turns edge-on, slices diagonally ONCE, turns back to show its veins, then sheds a few small green restorative sap motes toward the left. One blade, one hit.

art.name: Seeds of Doubt
art.sequence: A pair of heavy dark seed husks opens into seed-clamp jaws, snaps ONCE at the center, cracks and leaves a few trailing root threads that sag before dissolving. Physical seed impact with slowing roots, no question marks or text.

art.name: Leaf Grip
art.sequence: Three broad ribbed leaves fold into grasping fingers, reach inward and squeeze once around a central gap, bruise and crumple from pressure, then uncurl. Clear gripping action; no vine whip or cut.

art.name: Leaf Lash
art.sequence: One long flexible leaf rib bends into a whip, draws a wide S-shaped preparation, snaps its leafy tip once across the center, and curls slack with fluttering torn leaflets. Whole whip remains in each cell.

art.name: Thistle Hook
art.sequence: A single purple thistle burr on a thick curved stem draws back, swings one upward hooking strike, sheds a few pointed burr bristles at contact and uncurls downward. Distinct thistle head and hooked stem.

art.name: Canopy Resonance
art.sequence: An arched canopy of four broad veined leaves sways in sequence; one twisting stream of leaf-vein resonance curls around a central gap and opens once, then small sap motes return left and the canopy relaxes. No generic hurricane or repeated hit.

art.name: Winter Shard
art.sequence: A small six-sided clear ice shard rotates slowly among fine inward-sweeping snow grains; its facets align into a precise centered glint, then settle in a balanced orbit. Self accuracy focus, no flying attack shard or damage burst.

art.name: Whiteout Detonation
art.sequence: A compact rough white snowball draws wisps of powder inward, compresses into faceted ice, then breaks into ONE broad whiteout ring of snow chunks and cold blue dust which disperses. No thundercloud or fire explosion.

art.name: Brittle Point
art.sequence: A narrow brittle ice claw with three unequal chisel points flexes backward, thrusts its longest point into ONE precise contact, fractures tiny ice chips from its edge, then recoils. Three points are one claw, no triple hit.

art.name: Rime Hook
art.sequence: A thick crescent of rime-coated ice grows from a short curved frozen wrist, swings in ONE upward hooking impact, cracks its frosty outer crust and curls down again. Readable hook punch, not an icicle projectile.

art.name: Glacier Scissor
art.sequence: Two thick asymmetrical glacier slabs have curved cutting faces, pivot open, shear past one another ONCE at the center, rebound with small shattered ice plates and separate. Heavy ice shears, not teeth or claws.

art.name: Frostbite Lunge
art.sequence: A long narrow frozen tusk with a hollow dark blue core angles forward, lunges on a single hairline trail into ONE needle-point collision, sheds a few sharp frost crystals and withdraws. Precision lunge distinct from basic Frost Shard.

art.name: Leaf Strike
art.sequence: A broad folded leaf paddle draws back sideways, rotates flat, delivers ONE heavy diagonal slap that shakes loose a little sleepy pollen, then flexes back open. A blunt leaf strike, not a leaf blade cut.

art.name: Root Cut
art.sequence: A flattened woody root blade reveals growth rings and a pale splinter edge, rotates edge-on, makes ONE short shearing cut, chips off two bark flakes and turns broadside in recovery. No floating leaf.

art.name: Sickleleaf Scissor
art.sequence: Two asymmetrical sickle-shaped leaf edges on curved stems open like shears, cross shut ONCE at one central contact, rebound with a little recoil twitch and unfold. Large notched leaf blades, no insect or jaws.

art.name: Root Grip
art.sequence: A thick bundle of pale segmented roots reaches outward like grasping fingers, coils ONCE around a hollow central space, contracts with creaking purple pressure lines, then releases its loosening knots. Heavy restraining root magic, no whip.

art.name: Root Lash
art.sequence: A single long knotted root with small fibrous side roots winds into a tight spiral, uncoils in one long horizontal lash, makes ONE cracking tip contact, falls slack and recoils. Brown root distinct from green Leaf Lash.

art.name: Spore Torrent
art.sequence: Several small ochre mushroom gills tilt and release a corkscrewing jet of gold-green spores, the coherent stream wraps ONCE around a central gap, blooms into ONE dusty contact cloud and drifts away. No whole fungus creature, no repeated hits.

art.name: Root Ward
art.sequence: Five thick root stakes grow upward around a central hollow gap, interlock into a low woven living barricade, settle with a quiet amber sap glint, and remain protective before fading. Self defence buff: NO damaging flash, blow or hit star.

art.name: Spring Growth

art.name: Hive Call
art.sequence: Three overlapping chitin-scale plates and tiny folded wing-shaped rally chevrons gather around an OPEN protected centre, interlock, hold briefly, then unlock. A protective rally, no damaging strike.

art.name: Antenna Guard

art.name: Tollwave

art.name: Scythe Scissor
art.sequence: Two hooked serrated insect scythes draw apart, cross in ONE crisp X-shaped scissor cut and separate with a few resin chips. No whole creature.

art.name: Horizon Rend
art.sequence: A curved row of three scaled draconic talon fragments sweeps one long diagonal rend through an angular empty gap, leaving hard-edged scale chips. No dragon body.

art.name: Wyrmtooth Reap
art.sequence: One long hooked wyrm fang edged with overlapping scales sweeps upward in a hooked reap; three narrow ribbon-like slivers trail it and disintegrate after ONE contact.

art.name: Bastion Rend
art.sequence: A thick bevelled fortress-plate cleaver edge draws back then shears diagonally through a narrow contact point; rectangular plate chips spill after one impact.

art.name: Steel Cut
art.sequence: A slim polished steel edge makes one fast clean horizontal cut with two rigid straight wake segments and tiny cool metal shavings; no handle or full sword.

art.name: Rivet Gnaw
art.sequence: Two riveted cog segments mesh, compress a little spring, rotate apart and settle; mechanical assembly cue without a jaw or bite.

art.name: Sirocco Spiral
art.sequence: A tight conical spiral of DRY heated wind ribbons winds forward like a corkscrew, briefly compresses at one contact then unfurls into ember flecks. Distinct from a fireball.

art.name: Drake Spark
art.sequence: A jagged ember seed fractures into three small hooked fiery prongs that coalesce into ONE compact sparkling forward strike, then dim into ash.

art.name: Kiln Fracture
art.sequence: A small rough kiln-crust sphere develops glowing angular cracks, splits outward in one sharp plate-like flare and crumbles into cooling chunks.

art.name: Tide Turn
art.sequence: Two opposing low curled water currents pivot around each other, reverse their flow and merge into one low forward tidal crest before settling into ripples.

art.name: Hauteclear Cut
art.sequence: A long leaf-shaped sabre edge with a raised central vein curves through one elegant green crescent cut, trailing stiff thorn-shaped chips.

art.name: Hail Choir
art.sequence: Small six-sided frost shards float upward in an orderly layered choir, lock into a quiet cold canopy over an open centre, then drift gently apart. This is weather/status, NO damaging flash.

art.name: Parting Blow
art.sequence: A wrapped blunt forepaw-shaped strike silhouette withdraws, darts outward once with two short departing dust streamers, lands one compact hit and retreats. No whole character.

art.name: Dune Vault
art.sequence: A low sand crescent rises into a compact arch, rolls forward and drops into a small grounded dust veil. Several pebbles mark the grounded arc.

art.name: Burden of Ages
art.sequence: Three heavy angular sediment blocks compress vertically, sink together with a single grounded knuckle-like impact and release a low fan of gravel.

art.name: Dark Delve
art.sequence: A pointed dark earthen wedge thrusts up from a small scatter of soil, digs forward through empty space and collapses back into a low shaded trench cue.

art.name: Updraft Ember
art.sequence: A compact feathered plume of dry air curls upward with three coal-dark ember chips, flares once at its tip, then falls apart into light soot flecks.

art.name: Sky Dive
art.sequence: Two long tapered feather-shaped air blades tilt steeply downward in one diving V, make a small wind contact and sweep away close to the floor.

art.name: Unwritten Wish
art.sequence: An irregular four-point folded wish-star made of pearl-like facets opens from a small seed, presses forward into one broad soft-edged but pixel-crisp star contact and breaks into petals. No circular ring.

art.name: Starlit Detonation
art.sequence: A small cluster of five uneven faceted stars gathers, briefly forms a jagged crown-like constellation, blooms into one compact starburst then scatters.

art.name: Glimmer Kiss
art.sequence: A small bow-like knot of petal-shaped glimmer facets releases one low broad scalloped wave, a tiny single contact point and curling after-fragments. No lips or face.

art.name: Star Kiss
art.sequence: One compact four-point pearl spark travels on two bent ribbon traces, expands into a single diamond-petal flash and fades into three asymmetrical chips.

art.name: Oneiric Wings
art.sequence: A pair of folded moth-like THOUGHT WINGS made of angular glassy planes opens around an empty centre, drives one wave of fractured facets forward, then folds away. No living butterfly.

art.name: Mind Pulse
art.sequence: Three nested segmented hexagonal pressure plates gather, compress into one forward mental pulse and fracture into staggered straight bars after contact. No smooth magic circle.

art.name: Thought Spark
art.sequence: A branching lattice of short angular thought sparks forms a small prismatic knot, extends one uneven fork, makes one contact and snaps into short shards.

art.name: Wyrmwhisper
art.sequence: Three overlapping elongated scale-shaped breath wisps gather around an open central void, turn quietly in an ordered slow spiral, hold and disperse. Supportive focus, no damage flash.

art.name: Duality Crest
art.sequence: Two opposing small prismatic crest-halves fold together above an open centre, align into a balanced crown-like mental crest, pause then separate. A quiet self-focus buff, no impact.

art.name: Three-Ring Verdict
art.sequence: Three small broken crescent blades sweep sequentially along one curved path, converge as ONE interlocking three-lobed cut at contact, then break into petal facets. Not three repeated hits.

art.name: Wraith Scissor
art.sequence: Two ragged spectral sickle ribbons slide past each other in one scissor slash, leave torn empty gaps and detach into thin shroud-like chips. No metal weapon.

art.name: Chitin Needle
art.sequence: A narrow ribbed needle of pale chitin-light with three short trailing barbs extends forward in a single precise thrust, contacts once and splinters into tiny angled grains. Neutral material usable for bug/fairy/fighting thrust effects.

art.name: Breaker Aura
art.sequence: A compact folded ribbon of force forms a blunt wedge with layered palm-like pressure ridges, drives one piercing surge and uncoils into hard-edged streamers after contact.

art.name: Charm Veil
art.sequence: Four translucent petal-shaped armour panels gather around a hollow centre, overlap into a quiet scalloped protective veil, shimmer by shifting facets and unfold. No damaging flash.

art.name: Iron Ward
art.sequence: Four thick riveted steel plates rise around an open centre, lock into a boxy iron ward with visible hinges, settle and release. No damaging flash or explosion.

art.name: Royal Mandate
art.sequence: An angular iron crown and three overlapping bastion plates rise together above an open centre, lock into a disciplined protective crest, then lower and unlock. Quiet self-support, no impact.

art.name: Hold the Burh
art.sequence: Six small staggered stone-and-iron blocks assemble into a low crenellated defensive arch around empty space, hold against a harmless dust wisp and disassemble. No damage.

art.name: Scalequake
art.sequence: A compact cluster of overlapping cracked scales and stone plates draws inward, punches outward in ONE low radial quake and sheds angular gravel.

art.name: Basalt Tackle
art.sequence: A short blunt basalt boulder with fossil-like mineral ribs rolls and lunges once, strikes a small gravel fan, then crumbles into rounded stone chips.

art.name: Geode Detonation
art.sequence: An uneven geode closes around a tiny crystal core, splits open in one explosive mineral bloom and scatters large crystalline facets that quickly dull.

art.name: Marker Mending
art.sequence: A low chipped standing-stone fragment with a rough opaline core unfolds into one forward mineral pulse, then closes and sheds small luminous stone dust. No text/runes.

art.name: Silken Spiral
art.sequence: Four thin silk ribbons braid into a loose conical spiral, rush forward as one woven pressure front, fray at one contact and drift into fine cloth strands. No ghost creature or circular ring.

art.name: Felt Snare
art.sequence: A small knot of soft felt-like threads unravels into a broad loose mesh, tightens gently around an EMPTY centre, releases one small pressure knot then loosens into frayed ends. No complete creature, violent impact or neon web.

art.name: Wraith Pulse
art.sequence: A ragged folded shroud plume rises into three off-centre spectral fins, pushes forward in one hollow pulse and dissolves into pointed quill-like wisps. Distinct from the broad funeral fan.

art.name: Spectral Touch
art.sequence: Three thin ectoplasmic fingers made only of ragged mist extend from a folded spectral seed, touch ONE empty contact point together, withdraw and break into little ribbon loops. No full hand/character.

art.name: Grey Hunt
art.sequence: A low angular dark slash-wake shaped like a crouched arrowhead compresses, darts forward once with two trailing claw-like grooves and frays into smoke. No full animal.

art.name: Bridge Veil
art.sequence: Two narrow spectral cloth strips cross as a low bridge arch, slide forward as one short concealed lunge, make one muted contact and fall apart into ragged strips.

art.name: Flint Skewer
art.sequence: Three uneven flint chips align into one short serrated mineral spear, thrust forward once, snap at the tip on contact and fall as sharp stone fragments.

art.name: Crag Spire
art.sequence: A thin faceted crag spire rises from a handful of pebbles, angles forward into one tight projectile pulse and shatters into slender mineral splinters.

art.name: Dragonhorn Tackle
art.sequence: A thick curved dragon-horn fragment wrapped in two bands of scales drives forward in one blunt tackle, flares a compact contact and recoils through a few scale flakes. No complete head.

art.name: Aurora Reprieve
art.sequence: Three folded petal streamers and small uneven frost-pearl facets descend around a hollow protected centre, knit into a restorative garland, hold softly then drift apart. Healing/status, NO attack contact.

art.name: Sly Feint
art.sequence: Two short folded shadow-cloth ribbons swap positions around an empty centre, form a quiet off-centre sheltering hood, then slide away. Concealment self-buff, NO damaging slash or flash.

art.name: Cower
art.sequence: A small hollow dark shell-like canopy of three broad mineral plates curls inward protectively, settles low, then opens with two harmless dust motes. Quiet self-defence, no damage.

art.name: Fossil Memory
art.sequence: A worn fossil spiral embossed in a rough stone slab brightens along its natural seams, divides into three protective rock plates around empty space, holds and closes. No letters or runes, no attack.

art.name: Blackthorn Scissor

art.name: Cutpurse Reap
art.sequence: A narrow hooked dark-metal edge makes one short rising reap, followed by a stiff crooked shadow ribbon and three tiny cache-like angular chips.

art.name: Latent Power
art.sequence: A dense folded obsidian-like wedge coils inward, suddenly drives one short blunt burst through a narrow gap, then breaks into a low scatter of dark angular fragments. No magic ring.

art.name: Granite Cleave

art.name: Devilish Encore

art.name: Gale Sweep

art.name: Lunar Voyage

art.name: Chitin Hook

art.name: Chitin Cut

art.name: Earth Ward

art.name: Quicksand Resonance

art.name: Sky Focus

art.name: Bower Bash

art.name: Moonthorn Hook

art.name: Oathwall

art.name: Swarm Detonation

art.name: Mesmeric Hood

art.name: Kite Conductor
